The main steps of an IVF cycle are:

1. Stimulating the ovaries so several eggs mature.
2. Egg retrieval (egg collection).
3. Fertilising the eggs in the laboratory.
4. Transferring an embryo into the uterus.

During the cycle, you will also have monitoring scans and blood tests, a trigger injection

rows.text: Ovarian reserve describes the number—and broadly the quality—of eggs remaining in your ovaries. People are born with all their eggs, and this number declines over time: gradually until the early 30s, then more quickly after the mid-30s [1].

- Vomiting or being unable to keep fluids down
- Shortness of breath
- Passing little urine
- Rapid weight gain
